import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
B62txt="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0

I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
AL=B62txt.split("\n")[0].split(); idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AL)}
M20=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()[1:]] for r in B62txt.split("\n")[1:]],dtype=np.int32)
def encx(s):
    a=np.array([idx.get(c,-1) for c in s]); return a[a>=0]
def sw(a,b,go=11,ge=1):
    A,B=encx(a),encx(b); n=len(B)
    H=np.zeros(n+1,np.int32); E=np.full(n+1,-10**6,np.int32); best=0
    for i in range(len(A)):
        sc=M20[A[i]][B]; Hd=H.copy(); H[0]=0; F=-10**6
        for j in range(1,n+1):
            E[j]=max(E[j]-ge,H[j]-go); F=max(F-ge,H[j-1]-go)
            v=max(0,Hd[j-1]+sc[j-1],E[j],F); H[j]=v
            if v>best: best=v
    return best
def seqof(a):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text
    return "".join(t.split("\n")[1:])
CG13494="MDDTLSTVEGGMTETSSWSTTIATTTTTEAAKAGSMAVGIIVLIVVMVLLCCLLIICLPLLCLCGCCGLACSACLACDEGCCGEGGGGGCCGDDGGGCCGDGGGCGDCGDGCGDCTLDDD"
CG43405="MAELDATTLSEYDIEYIDFNMTTVAYRTTTGHPDTNLGAWGLLFIFVVIFLIIAACCACMGVLVLFGCMKSFLCFRCRRRGDEFIGREP"
cands={"D. simulans B4QGK9":"B4QGK9","D. erecta B3NNA4":"B3NNA4","D. yakuba A0A0R1DMP7":"A0A0R1DMP7",
       "D. yakuba A0A0R1E607":"A0A0R1E607","D. sechellia B4I7W1 (known ortholog)":"B4I7W1"}
rows=[]
for lab,a in cands.items():
    s=seqof(a)
    rows.append(dict(hit=lab,acc=a,aa=len(s),vs_CG13494=sw(s,CG13494),vs_CG43405=sw(s,CG43405),
                     pct_C=round(100*s.count("C")/len(s),1),seq=s))
t=pd.DataFrame(rows)
t["assignment"]=np.where(t.vs_CG13494>2*t.vs_CG43405,"CG13494 ortholog",
                  np.where(t.vs_CG43405>2*t.vs_CG13494,"CG43405 ortholog","ambiguous"))
print(t[["hit","aa","vs_CG13494","vs_CG43405","pct_C","assignment"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nD. erecta B3NNA4 sequence:\n ",t.loc[t.acc=="B3NNA4","seq"].iloc[0])
print("D. simulans B4QGK9 sequence:\n ",t.loc[t.acc=="B4QGK9","seq"].iloc[0])
print("D. yakuba A0A0R1DMP7 sequence:\n ",t.loc[t.acc=="A0A0R1DMP7","seq"].iloc[0])

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,4.3))
x=np.arange(len(t)); w=0.36
ax.bar(x-w/2,t.vs_CG13494,w,label="vs CG13494 (Q8MZA7)",color="#c0392b")
ax.bar(x+w/2,t.vs_CG43405,w,label="vs CG43405 (neighbour, 146 bp away)",color="#2c7fb8")
ax.axhline(121,color="#e67e22",ls="--",lw=1.4)
ax.text(len(t)-0.5,127,"composition floor (SW 121)",color="#e67e22",fontsize=8,ha="right")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([h.replace(" ","\n",1) for h in t.hit],fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("Smith-Waterman score"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("Assigning the best melanogaster-subgroup hits to CG13494 or to its neighbour CG43405",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
